sourcing_note: Sourced from FierceBiotech's 2024 clinical trial flops retrospective, which flagged Sage Therapeutics' dalzanemdor program as a 'trio of phase 2 failures across a stock-crushing seven-month run.' The Huntington's readout (DIMENSION, Nov 2024) was already added in an earlier batch; these two are the other members of the trio (Parkinson's PRECEDENT, April 2024; Alzheimer's LIGHTWAVE, October 2024). Chosen specifically because SAGE was already confirmed to clear the investability floor in two prior determinations, making these near-certain passes rather than speculative new-company bets - deliberately higher-confidence sourcing than betting on an unverified company. Deduplicated against the full existing ticker/candidate_id set (confirmed the FierceBiotech 'Losmapimod' 2024 entry is the same event as the already-processed P3-2024-FULC-REACH, not a new one).

events.indication: mild cognitive impairment associated with Parkinson's disease
events.notes: PRECEDENT study did not meet its primary endpoint (WAIS-IV Coding Test at Day 42). Company discontinued dalzanemdor in Parkinson's; the Huntington's and Alzheimer's readouts followed later in 2024 with the same negative outcome (see NEG-P2-2024-SAGE-LIGHTWAVE and the already-processed P2-2024-SAGE-DIMENSION).

events.indication: mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia in Alzheimer's disease
events.notes: LIGHTWAVE study did not meet its primary endpoint (WAIS-IV Coding Test at Day 84). Company discontinued further dalzanemdor development in Alzheimer's disease - the third and final leg of the 2024 dalzanemdor failure trio alongside PRECEDENT (Parkinson's) and DIMENSION (Huntington's, already processed).
